$doc: The texture pack, the file the cube kind's palette entry is drawn from: one image
of every tile under asset/content/cube/, which the asset ingest composes
and ships as the table's file at this path, with which tile each cube
wears on which face (pxl-tool bin/ingest_asset.rs, ingest.json); the
catalog names it as the cube kind's `pack` slot (pxl_spec::asset::catalog).
What a cell shows when nothing painted it: a cell with nothing on it is
still land, as Carto's background is.

sentinel.name: void
$doc: nothing painted: the ground before a bake writes it, and an object cell no leaf holds

sentinel.name: unknown
$doc: bedrock, where the world holds no more: the floor under the ground and the wall just inside the service area (`pxl-spec limit.rs`); a cell past the area or the coverage, which no source here describes, reads as it and is drawn as nothing, as is a byte no bake wrote: 0xFF, so memory filled with 0xFF reads as unknown; nothing is placed on or taken from it
The ground: one byte a cell, a palette entry from OpenStreetMap Carto, numbered in
`transport` marks a way: decor faces along it and no pier stands on it;
every palette entry stands at its sampled height. The byte's values: 1 to 63
Carto's palette entries, in its paint order; from 64 pixelet's own, the
underground, which Carto paints nothing of; 0 and 255 the sentinels.
